subject.title: [Feature]: Support configurable request labels for Gemini API calls (GCP billing tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw add a Vertex-only Google request-label config surface for billing attribution, and what exact static/dynamic label shape should be public?
rationale: The code change is straightforward only after maintainers choose the public config contract, whether labels apply only to `google-vertex`, and whether OpenClaw-owned dynamic labels such as agent or skill are in scope.

options.title: Add Vertex-only static labels
options.body: Expose validated static labels for the native `google-vertex` request body and document that non-Vertex Gemini calls are not labeled unless official support is proven.

options.title: Broaden to dynamic OpenClaw labels
options.body: Design a larger policy that can add agent, skill, or session labels, accepting more privacy, cardinality, and config-surface review.

options.title: Leave to proxies or external plugins
options.body: Close or defer this as operator-specific billing attribution handled outside the bundled Google provider.

recommendation.title: Add Vertex-only static labels
recommendation.body: Expose validated static labels for the native `google-vertex` request body and document that non-Vertex Gemini calls are not labeled unless official support is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider transport ownership and public config policy, and this owner has recent history on the Google transport/plugin boundary.
